scripts.test:browser: npm run test:browser --workspace @wlearn/ensemble && npm run test:browser --workspace @wlearn/automl
scripts.test:all: npm run test:js && npm run test:py-core && npm run test:browser
scripts.test:py-core: PYTHONPATH=py python3 -m pytest py/tests/test_ecosystem.py py/tests/test_properties.py py/tests/test_automl.py py/tests/test_bundle.py py/tests/test_registry.py py/tests/test_scalers.py py/tests/test_ensemble.py py/tests/test_composite_load_hardening.py py/tests/test_pipeline_fit.py -q
scripts.test:interop:minimal: npm run test:interop:guards && npm run test:interop:js && npm run test:interop:py && npm run test:interop:reverse
scripts.test:interop:full: npm run test:interop:guards && npm run test:interop:js && npm run test:interop:py:full && npm run test:interop:reverse:full
